profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Apple | Former VP of Engineering
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer at Apple with a background spanning hands on software engineering, product development, and engineering leadership across consumer products, enterprise software, and startup environments.

Over the course of my career, I have built and led software teams, shipped products from concept to launch, and worked on technically challenging problems in areas including fitness, health, artificial intelligence, media delivery, pattern recognition, video games, and motion capture. Prior to Apple, I served as VP of Engineering, leading teams and execution across fast moving product organizations.

My work includes patented innovations, published research, and products that contributed to venture growth, acquisitions, and commercial outcomes. I am especially interested in building technology that combines strong engineering, thoughtful product design, and real world impact.

positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Bringing together thoughtful design with breakthrough engineering.

positions.title: VP of Engineering
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Acquired by Humana in 2023. Led engineering across mobile, backend, and web platforms at Heal, supporting the development of key products including HIPAA compliant telemedicine, a clinical EHR built on FHIR and HL7, and remote patient monitoring solutions. Helped scale the company nationally, supported major product and organizational growth, and contributed in raising over $120 million in funding.
positions.insights: Skills: iOS Development · Ruby · Enterprise Software · Swift · Executive Leadership · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Machine Learning

positions.title: Founder and Head of Engineering
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Led engineering and product delivery across mobile and web platforms at Modernistik, building and launching software for clients across a range of industries. Managed interdisciplinary teams, helped shape product strategy and user experience, and delivered full stack solutions supporting more than 1 million global mobile app users. Known for turning early stage ideas into production ready products across multiple platforms and technology stacks.

positions.title: Chief Product Officer and Engineering Lead
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Led product and engineering at GigTown, owning the development of the company’s platform from early concept through launch and growth. Built and scaled the core software stack across web and mobile, led the engineering team, and drove product design and user experience. The platform grew to more than $1.5 million in annual recurring revenue within its first two years and later contributed to the successful acquisition of GigTown.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Senior Software Engineer at Qualcomm working across mobile, web, and backend systems for consumer and internal products. Led server and mobile UI development efforts across multiple projects and contributed to technologies spanning multimedia delivery, mobile applications, user interfaces, gesture recognition, and gaming. Awarded 8 patents across mobile software, interaction design, human gesture recognition, gaming, and over the air multimedia delivery.

positions.title: Founder and Principal Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Founded and built Addicted2Salsa into a global digital media and software platform reaching more than 1 million users and subscribers, with over 128 million video views and several hundred thousands of YouTube subscribers. Led product, design, engineering, and infrastructure across web and mobile platforms, building the applications and backend systems that supported several hundred thousand visits and more than 5 TB of video delivery each month. The business generated recurring monthly revenue through a combination of content, software, and digital distribution.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Conducted research in multimedia forensics, cryptography, cybercrime forensics, and digital watermarking while completing graduate studies at Iowa State University. Focused on multimedia collusion detection, with work contributing to three major papers, two book publications, and recognition as an M.S. and Ph.D. GEM Fellowship recipient.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Built web based network scanning and monitoring tools in support of infrastructure security and operational reliability, helping improve visibility and reduce risk across production environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software tools to automate testing workflows and improve deployment efficiency for IBM server products. Also built web applications that provided real time infrastructure visibility and reduced administrative overhead.

projects.title: Get Heal
projects.description: Developed and delivered key flagship features such as HIPAA compliant video telemedicine, secure file exchange, improved integration with Apple HealthKit, Single-Sign On, and support for 40 million users on Medicare, helping the company expand to new markets in California, Georgia, New York, New Jersey and Washington.
